Tax Foundation: 2022 VAT Rates in Europe (table as of January 2022, sourced from the European Commission's Taxes in Europe Database)

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
Romania's 21% standard and single 11% reduced rate reflect the August 2025 consolidation as listed by the Commission (table checked 2026-07-13).

From 1 August 2025 (Law 141/2025) the standard rate rose from 19% to 21% and the former 5% and 9% reduced rates were consolidated into a single 11% reduced rate (ANAF). The superseded 19%, 9% and 5% rows are lower bounds; a 9% transitional rate still applies to some pre-contracted residential purchases until 30 September 2026.
